policy: An entry requires a reason grounded in published nomenclature or biological meaning.
No entry may be added because it improves a benchmark, gate or test number.
No entry may encode an identity taken from the 30-paper development pilot.
Entries are typography and naming facts only. They never assert lineage, tropism or any other biology.
Keep this file small and human-reviewable.

generic_terms.reason: Class-level mentions. A class is not a candidate, so these never receive a profile.

unresolved_markers.reason: A mention qualified by one of these words names something the text has not identified. Attaching it to a concrete candidate would be false attribution, so it stays unresolved.

non_candidate_terms.reason: Known entities that are not AAV capsid candidates. Each is excluded on biological meaning, not to change any metric. Matched on the exact normalized form only.

terms.reason: AAV receptor (KIAA0319L) — a host cell protein, not a vector.
AAV-phage hybrid particle — a bacteriophage chimera, not an AAV capsid candidate.
AAV-like particle — an antigen-display scaffold, not a delivery candidate.
POROS CaptureSelect AAVX — an affinity chromatography resin, not a vector.
